newsitem.title: USA: Jet fuel diffs steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Jet fuel diffs steady in thin trade.

text.p: Jet fuel was offered at higher prices to no avail Tuesday amid balanced supplies and tepid demand which left values steady.
"There are some that are trying to sell at a higher value, but the market does not have any clear direction" said a New York Harbor dealer.
Prompt low sulphur jet fuel was offered at 2.50 cents over NYMEX July heating oil after being offered at 2.00 cents Monday.

Prompt airline quality 54 grade in the U.S. Gulf was offered at 0.50 cent below July heating oil, slightly above the offer of 0.60 cent under on Monday. No deals were reported to confirm the stronger level, however.
